stories.title: Countries willing to pay more for stable energy supply from Canada, Hogan says
stories.summary: OTTAWA — Countries are willing to pay more to sign long-term energy supply deals with Canada because it can offer both security and stability, Calgary MP Corey Hogan said at an energy conference Monday.

stories.title: Freeman Johnson, the oldest of the dwindling number of Pearl Harbor survivors, dies at 106
stories.summary: BOSTON (AP) — Freeman Johnson, the oldest of the few remaining Pearl Harbor survivors, has died. Johnson died Saturday at his home in Centerville, Massachusetts. He was 106, according to one of his daughters, Diane Johnson.

stories.title: Higher gas, grocery prices keep inflation elevated at 3.1% despite relief elsewhere
stories.summary: OTTAWA — Canada's inflation rate held steady in October as higher prices for gas, groceries and clothes were partly offset by cheaper cellphone plans and slower rent price growth, Statistics Canada said Monday.

stories.title: Canadian Natural buying Advantage Energy in deal valued at $2.53B, including debt
stories.summary: CALGARY — Canadian Natural Resources Ltd. is adding to its footprint in the Montney and Charlie Lake areas of northwestern Alberta with a deal to buy Advantage Energy Ltd. for $2.53 billion, including debt.

stories.title: Carney in China to meet with President Xi, leaders from across Pacific Rim
stories.summary: SHENZHEN — Prime Minister Mark Carney arrived in China Monday, where he is set to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping and leaders from across the Pacific Rim.
